Product Features

  • This cabinet combines warm natural wood with a sturdy black metal frame. The harmonious colour combination gives any room a modern, elegant atmosphere and ensures a durable, stable overall structure.
  • The clear division into upper cabinet area, open middle zone and closed lower section allows perfect organization of various items. Everything has its place – from documents to decorative objects.
  • The upper storage compartment with double-leaf doors offers space for small everyday items, files or dishes that should remain protected from dust. The doors open quietly and allow comfortable use.
  • In the lower area, an adjustable shelf ensures that even larger items or items of different heights can be easily stowed away - from folders to kitchen utensils.
  • Smooth surface finish, rounded edges and careful workmanship increase the safety and value of the cabinet. The metal structure provides extra stability and durability.
  • Whether in the living room as a sideboard, in the dining room for dishes, in the office for files or in the study for the combination of presentation and storage - this cabinet fits into any modern environment.
